chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Al-Hasan ibn Salih, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed, Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ordered Qanbar to administer a hadd punishment to a man, but Qanbar erred and gave him three extra lashes. So Ali عليه السلام exacted retribution from Qanbar with three lashes.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Title of Imam Ali عليه السلام, meaning the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.غَلِطَ: He made a mistake or erred

ai.seo_question: What did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام do when extra lashes were mistakenly added in a hadd punishment?
ai.summary: This report narrates that Amir al-Mu'minin عليٌّ عليه السلام enforced justice even when an excess occurred during the implementation of a legal punishment. When Qanbar mistakenly added three lashes, Ali عليه السلام required equivalent retribution from him, showing precision and accountability in the justice system.
